name: Chad
headline: Chad: +5.1% growth in 2025, −2.6% inflation, debt 33% of GDP
sections: Chad is a $22.0 billion economy (2025), the world's 132nd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +5.1% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $2,903 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 6.3% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose −2.6% in 2025, in deflation, down from 5.8% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 1.1% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 1.5% (2025).
Gross government debt is 33% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 42% in 2020. The general government balance is −0.3% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −0.6% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 46% of GDP (2025), a relatively closed economy. Net FDI inflows were 0.0% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 25% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 55.2 years (2024). Population: 19.0 million (2025).
